note: Morgan County WV abolished county planning and zoning in the late 1990s, so unincorporated land has no zoning districts. Berkeley Springs (Town of Bath) zones its own land, but its site and the county GIS pages publish no zoning district layer or service. The ArcGIS Online item 'Morgan County Zoning Map' (fb5c948f...) and services6 Parcels/ParcelZoning layers belong to Morgan County, Colorado, not WV. No queryable WV zoning service was found.
